comment: Didnt finish. Went back but good trail in the forest

Arrowhead is a beautiful site. The lake is small but the park is very big. Lots of nice spots along this trail, and works well in combination with the Mayflower and falls trails for a longer hike. Buggy in the summer but fine if you keep moving!
Little wet today. But it was manageable
Beaver meadow portion was closed so we did the lake trail instead! Super fun!

Pleasant walk on a ski / biking trail. Entrance to trail wasn’t well marked from the Visitor Centre. Certain sections had many bugs. Other sections crossed beaches and parking lots. Several longish slopes.
Once you get to the trail head it's easy.  However,  the park has no discernible signs to get to the trialhead.
quite a nice trail, lots of good foliage. lookout slightly crowded but still very beautiful. well maintained trail.
Bring lots of bug spray.
Great for a morning walk when camping. Went the morning after a rainfall, obviously mosquitoes were quite dense. Trail is well marked.
Loved the hike with amazing scenic Arrowhead Lake views!
Bring bug spray
Trail was very well marked and easy to walk!

I did Stubbs Falls and Arrowhead Lake trail.  Mix of snow ice and mud.  I had waterproof boots, gators and poles to navigate the tricky parts.  Went off trail twice on Arrowhead trail due to low lying floods.  Check at visitor centre as to which trails are open. On the plus side lots of parking, and enjoyed the fireplace at the visitor centre.
Skiing was great with 3/4 elevation changes
Easy walking trail
Easy afternoon walk around the lake
Nice walk around the lake. 2 hills, manageable but if on bikes watch for rocks and roots. Always beautiful in fall
Nice easy walk
We cycled this.  Lots of roots and loose gravel

The magic of pure Muskoka  
The leaves are about 50% the colors are light up the forest.   The trail is well marked. The waterfalls were stunning!
not much area to seat and rest. There was some empty camp area that we used to rest.
Not many views of lake as you walk round
Not exceptionally scenic. Mostly forest views
Easy, clean, great view!
Not much access to water. Bring some for your dog!
Busy but lovely.
Not the most scenic hike, but a nice length and you can always jump in the lake along the hike too.
Too much bugs
Lake is beautiful but trail is not on water's Edge.  The Solitaire Lake trail at Limberlost Forest is better.  Beaches / swim areas look great.
Very buggy this year!
Steep hills. Be prepared with lots of water!
Nice easy trail with some short steep climbs. Wide paths good for dog walking. Not much signage at some intersections so use map. Kayak/SUP hire available.

Watch for signage. We couldn’t find the start of the trail but did eventually see a teeny pink sign that steered us in the right direction. 
If you want to swim, you will pass a beach area. 
And bring bug spray.
Great condition.. nice trail!
Trail off beaver was a bit confusing. Not sure if we were on the right trial or not but turned around and was nice to walk down to the beach parking.
Great trail. Some of it is sandy, some rocky. Has a couple hills but mostly flat. Great views and nice stops at the water to let the pups cool off.
Basic trials - in the forest not many views on the lake / be ready if you are coming in June : lot of mosquitos !!
The trail is nice and not too challenging.  Make sure you bring insect repellent.  The mosquitoes are crazy here!  Great trail overall and very friendly people working in the visitor centre.
Trail around the lake close to campgrounds. Nothing special
Very enjoyable trail, a few ups and downs. Good track setting
We went to do this trail in the winter but it was only open to cross country skiers.   The hiking trails were great (accessed  by Stubbs Falls trail entrance)

Snow, a lots of lovely snow!!
 Stubb's fall trail - short, easy, lovely view of the falls, too packed snow for snowshoes.  A lots of people.
Arrowhead Lake trail - beautiful, with a lot of elevation changes.  Snow  makes the trail really moderate one, but the views on the snowy forest and ice-covered lake make it  worthwhile to do. No people.
Nice and wide.  Easy to navigate.  Good parking
Taking it from the right saves you a strenuous climb.
Beautiful views. Busy on the weekend
Not too long, pretty easy to walk!

Two small sand beach

Gorgeous blustery “fall” day in mid August.

Beautiful trail

A few steep hills but generally easy walking! Stoped for a swim
at the dog beach! Beautiful beach with a dock!
Fairly easy trail with some small hills.
Nice easy trail.  Buggy.  Not much available in the way of lake views.
A little buggy but to be expected.

Trail was very busy even for a summer weekend. Groups of anywhere from 3-10 people would be stopped on the trail, or taking photos, or generally crowding the trail. Also many cyclists use the trail in both directions, which made it tricky for anyone to pass in some sections. Not that many nice views either.
Very buggy but nice views. Moderate elevation changes. Wear pants.
No Deet exists that could prepare you for the section by Beaver Meadows. Essentially every time you can’t see Arrowhead Lake, you will be covered head to toe in mosquitos and black flies.
Stubbs Falls trail was nice. Part of the loop was muddy but the falls was worth the hike. You could get right down there by the water.
Nice little hike around the lake. Bring your bug spray and you’ll be fine.
Bug repellent is your friend
Wide trail. Multipurpose, easy stroll. Lots of bugs in the spring but that’s to be expected. Forested trail with limited lake views.
$21 day pass per vehicle, lots of different trail options. Very nice visitor centre with clean bathrooms and little gift shop.
No muddy patches at present, a nice stroll around the lake at arrowhead provincial park.  Gentle walk with some steep inclines.  Well sign posted.
Some fantastic moss, fungi and ferns.  Beautiful
Had some nice views of the lake. A little muddy in some spots but expected for early May

Very nice trail!
A little hilly if that’s not for you, and connecting beaver meadow trail is closed!
Pretty trail, trail path is wide, walks along the river.  Easy walk except for the mud - really muddy.  Also caution tape up in two areas because of a falling tree (which you can crawl under).
Lots of ice so crampons are a good idea. There is some muddy sections though. Took a detour to Stubb's Falls and on one side all ice. The other side mainly dry to muddy.
There are skating trail, hiking/snow shoeing trail and cross country trail. Trails are amazing!!
Cold. Glorious snow !!
Beautiful. Nice easy hike around the lake.
Trails are in great shape some ice some mud. Perfect weather for Dec. 29th
Hard to follow. Icy right now
Dec 26th icy but easy walk
Beautiful trail, no mud, ice patches is some parts,

Easy 5K hike. Parking at visitor's center provides good access to the trail.  Trail was dry and easy to navigate even being leaf covered at this time of the year. Encountered few other hikers on this midweek hike.  Expectbit would be much busier on weekends.

Little peaks at the lake throughout the trail. Very beautiful in the fall. Trail was wide and easy to walk along, but not very well marked (fairly easy to accidentally wander onto another intersecting trail)
Beaver Meadow Trail currently closed, 11 Oct 2023.

Arrowhead Lake with Stubbs Falls rather than the separate lot. Stubbs Falls is absolutely overloaded with people (in the fall) but the lake is comparatively empty. Thing is, it's also not the most interesting trail. The best views of the lake are near the beginning, in fact, and you don't get much the rest of it. But the trail is very well kept and has some pretty sections in the fall. Don't forget to visit the most awe-inspiring section of the park: the big Bend Lookout (also fork able from this trail)
Careful if biking hills are rocky
Beautiful area! Mosquitos weren’t bad at all
Minor miss haps on my part lol but beautiful and worth it!
Easy
Nice and peaceful trail around the lake but nothing special
Clearly marked trail. Pretty easy walk.
Well marked, very nice in august, not overgrown. Mosquitos are plentiful. Dogs are allowed on trail with leash
Nice trail around the lake. Few hills.
Nice easy walk, not too difficult. Paid entrance to the park per vehicle though
Part of this trail was closed so it was only 4.9 kms, not over 6 kms as described.
Not the best trail markings but pretty good

An easy trail to explore with family of all ages, however you may have to carry the whee ones as you come to the end.
Wasn’t easy to follow the trail, just did to and back to the big bend lookout
Nice woodland walk but not many views of the lake due to the trees. Pretty easy with a few steep climbs.

Great day for a spring hike. Some spots still have snow and trail is wet/muddy in spots. Water proof footwear very helpful
Still muddy and icy in some parts.

Beautiful spring walk. Just in time before the snow really melts and it’s really muddy
Nice leisurely stroll. Perfect trail for everyone.
Beautiful!  Nice views of the lake.

Easy quick trail
Pretty uninteresting trail. Really no good lake views except at the start.  Colours were still nice.  Easy hike -- at least half is on road-like width, with few ups and downs.
It’s a beautiful trail with beautiful scenery. Well marked. Was a little muddy due to the rain but it didn’t affect the hike. Enjoy it!
Easy walk and pretty.  Most leaves are gone already though, makes very pretty carpet.
Lookouts are a bit busy but the trails are nice. Park before 11am or they may run out of parking space
Nice place

Fairly easy walk trail with a few lookouts hidden off the track.  It is great opportunity to explore by yourselves. Although it is 5.2km officially, you can extend or merge to other trails for something exciting.
A fine trail. Mostly in the woods. Nice terrain with some lake views.Part of it is along the public beaches and campsites. The Beaver Meadow side trail is sadly closed.
Nice trail, but you don’t see a lot of the lake.
Well maintained and decent trail, but quite uninteresting. Good for walking dogs or casual walks, but not much to see
Great hike.
Well maintained and easy to follow. Definitely more of a walk than anything.
Truly a "walk in the park," less of a hike.

We did this as a recovery walk after a longer trail earlier in the day. It was just what we needed. A few small hills, like others have noted but not overly challenging. The trail is well maintained and wasy to follow. We loved seeing the big, green ferns on either side while we hiked through the forest.
Great - bring swim suit!
I started from the Roe beach area. Easy hike, a few small hills, great way to see the lake. Stopped at the dog beach to cool off half way around the loop.
Could use more lookouts along the way. Areas of very loose stone for cycling
Well maintained but opens into parking lots a few times
A mix of everything. Sandy beach, smooth bike trail, beautiful Mayflower lake, and finished with a bumpy Hardwood trail.
Great conditions even though it rained hard the previous day. Lots of bugs - bug spray recommended.  Great views of the lake, and even a stretch on the beach. Highly recommended.
Nice stroll in the woods
Wonderful. Great hike.
Takes barely an hour
very easy walk

It was about $22 to get into the park for a day pass and if you feel up for it you can take a dip in the lake as there are a couple beaches that you walk by.
Wide well-maintained trail. Accessible to anyone capable of walking 10km.
Very nice trail. Not many photo opportunities. But very nice.
Made my own loop which I hope you enjoy!
Bugs were quite bad at first but cleared up. I do this trail 12-15 times a year and doesn’t really constitute a hike but it’s a lovely walk.
Beautiful area, but a bit muddy in some spots. Great day!
Bit squishy in spots. Hiking poles probably saved us from wiping out a few times.
great birding!
fresh powder

Really beautiful area and so many trails/activities around the entire park. This trail is only for skiing in the winter though, no hiking is prohibited. might be common knowledge but we didn’t know when starting. Lots of other trails and small rivers around that are accessible via hiking :) and not too slippery!
Trail was very iced over and slippery. Lovely views and invigorating walk!

overall, really nice trail with wide and we'll maintained pathways. could be marked a bit better (especially where it cuts through the campgrounds and along the beach) but otherwise very enjoyable. beaver trail loop is closed as of this post (Nov 8/21)
trail mostly closed... what's open is super muddy

Partly closed but still great
Part of Stubb’s Falls was very muddy, would recommend using the trail from the campground.
Wide and easy to walk. Nice Lake views at points. Not too hilly. Walked with the kids.
Nice day.

Have to go counter clockwise along the trail otherwise is very poorly marked. Would be nice to have some more water lookouts. All in all a very nice trail
nice easy walk

Nice little loop. I did the 5km around the lake as Beaver Meadows was closed.  Wide-well maintained trail; would be fun on a bike.  Whole thing took about an hour, but I jumped in the lake after for a swim and forgot to turn the app off lol
A very flat trail, but I would say perfect for a nice stroll through the woods where you don’t want to deal with too many roots, obstacles, etc. Hardly any bugs and great for a walk on a hot day!

Nice, easy trail with hard packed dirt or gravel. A few elevation changes, notably the “cheese grater”, named by the Rangers for the loose rock rock scree which can rip up cross country skis in the winter!

ly. its basically a bush trail wide enough for a car. Not very scenic. if you want the best of the best go to Kilarney. on the other hand my wife really enjoyed it.

Very easy trail, great for a longer walk. It has some nice views of the lake but not as many as you would expect. Parts wind through Lumpy Camp and the beach parking lot. It’s a good trail, but not the best in the park.

First of all, this trail is only 5kms - if you add Beaver Meadow, it is 9km. As someone previously pointed out, it’s a walk more than a hike as you are traveling mostly on old roads and it’s not very scenic - I would never return to this trail.
nice trail.  very easy.  much of the trail has views of the lake through the trees.
Good ride - great elevation changes
Nothing special
Very buggy but beautiful!

This is an easy walk which would be more picturesque when there is no foliage. Around the lake itself is only 5km according to the park map. As there was no one around and I didn't think to bring a bathing suit, a naked dip in the lake was perfect on this rather warm day.

This is a walk on a former road. The trail outlined here just loops back through a campground for distance. The vast majority of this trail is on old pavement or gravel, at least ten feet wide. More a walk than a hike
Virtually empty at 10:30 in the morning. 70% ice/snow and 30% mud/frozen mud. Very tranquil, easy and flat terrain. Crampons helped a lot.

i star rated many trails and this is my first comment on a hike.
dont waste your time on winter hiking at this park.
$21 to park and only 3 trails open to hike, the rest is for cross country skiing. poorly mark and when we ened up on a ski trail were told we could be fined . maybe summer this park is better but for winter hiking there are plently of free trails 100% better then this place .
easy trail.  wide trail at many points.  mostly flat. approx 10km about 2 hrs.
Gorgeous fall hike from mid-September to mid-October. Very wide and smooth surfaced trails, Nordic ski trail in winter.
Nice hike!
Nice views, easy way, and we were able to see even a black bear cub!
A great beginners trail.  Not a well marked trail but you’re going around the lake.  Pretty views of the lake.
Great trail for beginners with the family. A couple steep hills nothing serious and lots of wildlife and plants to see.
Hard bike. Lots of steep sections hard to pull the trailer.

nothing amazing. most of the trail seems to be a dirt road so it's not the most scenic. only real good thing about this walk is the lake and length.
It’s almost more of a bike trail, still nice to walk around. Moderate traffic.
great kid-friendly family trail

Awesome mountain biking track in great shape! There were 2 clear lines to follow - I had a blast!
